notes.title: Project Status Update: The Count of Monte Cristo
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]
After careful consideration, I’ve decided to close active development on [i]The Count of Monte Cristo[/i].
This demo represents a fully playable concept, a standalone slice of what could have been. As a solo developer, I’ve chosen to focus my energy on a different project that’s now further along: a psychological horror game called [i]The Last Transmission[/i].[/p][p]I’m proud of what was built, and grateful to everyone who supported the project. Though the full version of this game won’t be developed, the demo remains available as a finished glimpse into the world I wanted to explore.[/p][p]Thanks again for playing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345465/634abf3299cac601edd8a7e07bf63285c7a87296.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Count of Monte Cristo – Free Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
The time for revenge has come.

Step into Monte Cristo’s shoes and orchestrate the downfall of those who betrayed you. This narrative-driven tale of revenge, deception, and power puts you at the heart of an elaborate plan—where every move is yours to make.

Experience a short part of the story in this exclusive free demo.
After Edmond’s fall, you are thrust into the heart of Monte Cristo’s plan—where you decide how revenge unfolds.
Every choice matters in a world of high-stakes decisions.

Plan. Manipulate. Execute.

The Free Demo is now available—play it today!

Your feedback is invaluable—share your thoughts on Steam to help shape the full experience.

Will you be the master of your own fate?
